## About
Hunter's Custom Automotive sells aftermarket accessories to personalize your ride, and you can find them in our massive warehouse on E Trinity Ln. Custom wheels and tires, lift kits, bed covers, running boards and more.
We install what you buy with our experienced installers, and we also offer window tinting. Trucks, hot rods and classics all come through here, and we're always up for talking cars.
Folks on Google rate us 4.2 from 154 reviews. One reviewer came back years after his first visit to have new wheels, tires and a leveling kit put on his truck.

## Services
- Custom wheels and tires: Pick out a new set and we'll mount them on your car or truck.
- Lift kits, bed covers and running boards: Car and truck accessories to make your ride look and work the way you want.
- Installation: We install what you buy with our experienced installers.
- Window tinting: We also offer window tinting.
- Leveling kits: Two customers had leveling kits installed on their trucks. One said his truck looks like he wanted.
- Alignment on old vehicles: One reviewer said we got him in, took good care of his ole ride, and the price was surprisingly reasonable.

## FAQ
Q: Can you install the parts I buy from you?
A: Yes. We install what you buy with our experienced installers.

Q: Do you work on older cars and hot rods?
A: We do. One reviewer said we got his old vehicle in for an alignment and took good care of his ole ride.

Q: Where can I find out which car shows you'll be at?
A: Check our website banners for car show info, and follow us on Instagram and Facebook to see us on the road.
